# FoodLink Open Platform

FoodLink provides food image analysis, text meal analysis, nutrition database search, API credit billing, and a stdio MCP adapter for Codex, WorkBuddy, other agents, services, and hardware gateways.

## Start here

- AI integration guide: https://healthymax.cn/developer/ai-guide.md
- Human developer documentation: https://healthymax.cn/developer/docs/
- OpenAPI 3.1 schema: https://healthymax.cn/openapi/foodlink-openapi-v1.yaml
- Developer console: https://healthymax.cn/developer/console/
- MCP README: https://healthymax.cn/developer/mcp-readme.md

## Production API

- Base URL: https://api.healthymax.cn/open/v1
- Authentication: Authorization: Bearer <key> or X-API-Key: <key>
- Prefer FOODLINK_API_KEY_FILE. Never expose a full API key in chat, source code, logs, browser code, or firmware.
- Every analysis submission requires Idempotency-Key. Reuse it for retries of the same business request.
- HTTP 402 means insufficient credits. Stop and ask the user to open the developer console. Never pay automatically.

## Endpoints

- GET /account
- POST /uploads
- POST /food-analyses
- GET /food-analyses/{task_id}
- GET /foods/search?query=...&limit=...

## Analysis inputs

- text or image_urls: exactly one is required
- mode: standard or precision
- meal_type: breakfast, morning_snack, lunch, afternoon_snack, dinner, evening_snack
- additional_context: portion, leftovers, soup, sharing, or other user-provided context
- date: YYYY-MM-DD

For images: upload -> analyze -> poll. For text: analyze -> poll. Poll queued/processing tasks with backoff until completed, requires_action, or failed.

Do not expose or invent underlying model, provider, prompt, reasoning, or internal API parameters. Food analysis is an estimate, not medical diagnosis.
